IGUI_KEQ_Objective_0: Recover the rescue-frequency records from the south Louisville military checkpoint communications room.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_1: Find the designated medical equipment in Louisville hospital and secure the virus sample.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_2: Restore three designated panels at the south Louisville substation, then start the central grid terminal.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_3: Start the transmitter in the second-floor LBMW communications room.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_4: Broadcast a rescue signal on the military channel from the LBMW studio.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_5: Restore underground research access at the surface security terminal.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_6: Analyze the virus sample in the designated underground laboratory.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_7: Recover the military emergency frequency from the survivor radio in the lowest cave.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_8: Return to the surface communications room and start the emergency-powered rescue transmitter.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_9: Defend the facility until rescue arrives and enter the fenced 16×16 rooftop helipad.
IGUI_KEQ_Objective_10: The escape operation is complete. The world remains playable.
